<thought>To find the SN2 retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide (alkyl/aryl halide) and form a primary amine (the reverse of the forward SN2 where a nucleophilic amine attacks a halide). This matches the description of the required step.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
